questions.question: The sum of the salaries of A and B together is 45000. A spends 85% of his salary and B, 70% of his salary. If now their savings are the same, what is B’s salary?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sum of the salaries of A and B together is 45000

Savings of A and B are the same

**Calculation:**

According to the question:

⇒ A × 15% = B × 30%

⇒ A = 2 B

⇒ A/B = 2/1

Let the salaries of A and B be 2x and x, respectively.

Salaries of A and B = 45000

⇒ 2x + x = 45000

⇒ 3x = 45000

⇒ x = 15000

**∴ Salary of B = Rs. 15000**

questions.question: The distance between the centers of two circles of radius 3 cm and 2 cm is 13 cm. The length (in cm) of a transverse common tangent is:
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/660dadd729b8fe0f6e20badc3f6b2b0aa86f8f86404c6365d456272bded2713d.png] 

Let the radius of both circles be R and r and the distance between their center is d

Now,

R = 3 cm, r = 2 cm and d = 13 cm

Transverse common tangent (PQ)= √{d² - (R + r)²}

⇒ √{(13)² - (3 + 2)²} = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

questions.question: The average age of fifteen persons is 32 years. If two more persons are added, then the average is increased by 3 years. The new persons have an age difference of 9 years between them. The age (in years) of the elder among the new persons is:
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total age of 15 persons = 15 × 32 = 480

After adding 2 more persons the new average will be = 32 + 3 = 35

Now the total age of 17 persons = 17 × 35 = 595

Age of two new persons = 595 – 480 = 115

The two new people have an age difference of 9 years

Let the age of younger is x year and age of older is x + 9 years

∴ x + x + 9 = 115

⇒ 2x = 115 – 9 = 106

⇒ x = 53

**∴ The age of elder person = 53 + 9 = 62 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Deflection in the average = 3 years

The total age of 2 new persons = 2 × 32 + 3 × 17 (3 is the increment and 32 is the original average)

The total age of 2 new persons = 115

∴ x + x + 9 = 115

⇒ 2x = 115 – 9 = 106

⇒ x = 53

**∴ The age of elder person = 53 + 9 = 62 years**

questions.question: The compound interest on a certain sum of money at 21% for 2 years is Rs. 9,282. Its simple interest (in 2 years) at the same rate and for the same period is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

r = 21%

**Calculation:**

Compound interest rate for 2 years = (21 + 21 + 21 × 21/100) = 46.41 %

Let certain sum be P

∴ P × 46.41% = 9282

⇒ P × (4641/100 × 100) = 9282

⇒ P = Rs. 20000

Again for SI

P = 20000, r = 21%, t = 2 years

SI = P × r × t /100 = 20000 × 21 × 2/100 = Rs. 8400

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 8400.**

A man bought three articles for 30,000 each. He sold the articles respectively at 10% profit, 5% profit and 15% loss. The total percentage profit/loss he earned is:
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the C.P of article = Rs.100 each

Now

Total CP of three articles = 300

SP of first articles = 100 × 110/100 = 110

Now CP = SP

questions.question: A dealer buys an article marked at Rs. 20000 with two successive discounts of 20% and 5%. He spends Rs. 1800 on repairs and sells it for Rs. 20000, what is his profit/loss percent (correct to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

CP for dealer = 20000 × 80/100 × 95/100 = 15200

He spends Rs. 1800 on repairs

Total CP for dealer = 15200 + 1800 = 17000

SP for dealer = 20000

Profit = 20000 – 17000 = 3000

Profit percentage = (3000/17000) × 100 = 17.65%

**∴ The correct answer is 17.65%.**

questions.question: The ratio between the speeds of two trains is 2 : 5. If the first train runs 350 km in 5 h, then the difference between the speeds (in km/h) of both the trains is:
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the speeds of the both trains be 2x and 5x

Speed of first train = 350/5 = 70 km/h

∴ 2x = 70

⇒ x = 35

Difference between the speeds between them = 5x – 2x = 3x

Difference between the speeds between them = 3 × 35 = 105 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 105 km/h.**

If the seven-digit number 54x29y6 (x > y) is divisible by 72, what is the value of (2x + 3y)?
questions.solution:
**Concept Used:**

When a number is divisible by 72, it must be also divisible by 8 × 9

When a number is divisible by 8, then its last three digits will be also divisible by 8

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒ 9y6 is divisible by 8 when y = 3

Again, when a number is divisible by 9 then its sum of digit must be divisible by 9

⇒ 5 + 4 + x + 2 + 9 + 3 + 6 = 29 + x

Possible value of x = 7

Because 29 + 7 = 36 is divisible by 9

∴ 2x + 3y = 2 × 7 + 3 × 3 = 14 + 9 = 23

**∴ The correct answer is 23.**

A and B can complete a piece of work in 15 days and 10 days respectively. They got contract to complete the work for Rs. 75000. The share of B (in Rs.) in the contracted money will be:
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Ratio of number of days taken by A and B to complete the work = 15 : 10 = 3 : 2

Ratio of efficiency of A and B = 2 : 3

Let their share is in the ratio of 2x and 3x

Now

⇒ 2x + 3x = 75000

⇒ 5x = 75000

⇒ x = 15000

**∴ Share of B = 3x = 15000 × 3 = Rs. 45000**

questions.question: In which year the sum of the students in two school, is the highest?

In 2012 total number of students in school A and B = 900 + 500 = 1400

In 2009 total number of students in school A and B = 800 + 820 = 1620

In 2008 total number of students in school A and B = 640 + 550 = 1190
